relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP promotes both mRNA and protein expression of IL-23 in skin tissue via the PDK1–Rsk signaling pathway

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Upon activation, TRPV1 channels trigger the release of large amounts of CGRP from peripheral nerve endings

relationships.subject: Resolvin D3
relationships.evidence_quote: pharmacological inhibition of TRPV1 activity, using agents such as Resolvin D3 (RvD3), significantly reduces CGRP release

relationships.subject: Substance P
relationships.evidence_quote: SP directly activates mast cells through Mas-related G protein–coupled receptors

key_findings: Review: TRPV1+ sensory neurons release CGRP which drives dermal DC IL-23 and the IL-23/IL-17 axis in psoriasis
SP/NK1R and NGF/TrkA neuropeptide signaling link nerves, keratinocytes and immune cells in psoriasis
